title: Prompt - Clarity
evidence: The prompt is written in natural colleague voice with clear structure. It specifies: (1) Context — building a prototype for a gameplay review. (2) Four named input files with their purposes. (3) Visual authority hierarchy — scene_reference.png is the spec; gameplay_config.txt controls timing/physics; image wins on visual conflicts. (4) Gameplay mechanics — radial blast, gravity, bouncing, collection, auto-cycle, board repopulation. (5) 3D bomb panel requirements — viewport, camera, lights, positioning. (6) Exact telemetry formats with field definitions (MOTION_SAMPLE and ACTION_TRANSITION). (7) Three named deliverables with specific capture requirements. No ambiguity in what is asked. The telemetry format uses clear placeholder syntax with curly braces.
